archive.format: xz-compressed tar in ordered base64 chunks
restore_python_from_repository_root: import json, base64, hashlib, tarfile, io
archive.offline_replay: In a disposable restored copy run python -B verify.py from the restored vr49-fresh directory. For controls.rs place the frozen checkout at ../vr49-src and use rustc +1.95.0 --edition 2024 --test -Awarnings controls.rs, then execute controls. Offline replay uses stored symbols and disassembly.
